{% raw %}
{::nomarkdown}
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">

  <title>Zheng Tan | Academic Homepage</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='14' fill='%239e2435'/%3E%3Ctext x='32' y='41' fill='white' text-anchor='middle' font-family='Arial,sans-serif' font-size='27' font-weight='bold'%3EZT%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
  <style>:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --accent: #9e2435;
  --accent-dark: #7b1c2a;
  --accent-soft: #f7e9ec;
  --ink: #22252a;
  --muted: #60646c;
  --line: #e1e3e6;
  --paper: #ffffff;
  --pale: #f7f7f8;
  --night: #0f1218;
  --radius: 14px;
  --width: 1140px;
  font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 96px; }
body { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); line-height: 1.7; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
body, button, input { font-family: inherit; }
button, input { font-size: inherit; }
a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
a:hover { color: var(--accent-dark); }
button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
button:disabled { cursor: default; }
img, svg { max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; }
button, input, a, summary { outline-offset: 5px; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ac5361; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
h1, h2, h3, p, figure { margin: 0; }
ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.3; }
.container { width: min(var(--width), calc(100% - 48px)); margin-inline: auto; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; z-index: 100; top: 9px; left: 16px; transform: translateY(-160%); background: white; border: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-weight: 650; }
.skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }
.icon { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.arrow { display: inline-block; margin-left: 5px; transition: transform .2s ease; }
a:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }
.masthead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; background: rgba(255,255,255,.97); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
.header-row { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 76px; gap: 24px; }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-right: auto; color: var(--ink); }
.brand:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.brand-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 10px; color: white; background: var(--accent); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.4px; }
.brand-name { display: block; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: -.4px; line-height: 1.4; }
.brand-subtitle { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 1.05px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.site-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }
.site-nav a { display: block; padding: 24px 0; color: #42464c; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color .2s, border-color .2s; white-space: nowrap; }
.site-nav a:hover, .site-nav a[aria-current="location"] { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }
.language-toggle { min-width: 45px; min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 10px; color: #494d53; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.language-toggle:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: #ddbdc3; color: var(--accent); }
.menu-toggle { display: none; place-items: center; min-width: 42px; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: white; color: var(--ink); border-radius: 8px; }
.hero { color: white; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 5%, rgba(158,36,53,.18), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 6% 98%, rgba(158,36,53,.09), transparent 45%), var(--night); }
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1fr; gap: 46px; align-items: center; padding-block: 60px 42px; }
.eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #daa8b1; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .9px; line-height: 1.6; text-transform: uppercase; }
.eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 24px; height: 2px; flex: none; background: #ba4b5c; }
.hero h1 { margin-top: 21px; color: #fff; font-size: clamp(46px, 5.2vw, 68px); line-height: 1.05; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -2.7px; }
.hero-title { margin-top: 17px; max-width: 490px; color: #f0f0f3; font-size: clamp(24px, 2.7vw, 31px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.6px; }
.hero-description { margin-top: 20px; max-width: 480px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.85; color: #c3c6cf; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 27px; }
.button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 99px; padding: 10px 21px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.4; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s; }
.button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.button-primary { background: var(--accent); color: white; box-shadow: 0 5px 22px rgba(158,36,53,.18); }
.button-primary:hover { color: white; background: #b33044; }
.button-outline { border-color: #55545d; background: rgba(255,255,255,.035); color: #f1eff2; }
.button-outline:hover { color: white; background: rgba(255,255,255,.09); border-color: #8d7b82; }
.hero-location { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 7px; margin-top: 25px; color: #999eaa; font-size: 11px; }
.hero-location .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: 3px; }
.hero-visual { min-width: 0; }
.mosaic { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.mosaic-tile { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 1.2; border: 1px solid #34333e; border-radius: var(--radius); background: #141a24; isolation: isolate; }
.mosaic-tile img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform .4s ease; }
.mosaic-tile::after { position: absolute; z-index: 0; inset: 40% 0 0; content: ""; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(7,9,14,.88)); pointer-events: none; }
.mosaic-tile:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
.mosaic-tile .tile-label { position: absolute; z-index: 1; bottom: 13px; left: 15px; right: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: #f2f3f7; line-height: 1.35; }
.tile-number { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 11px; left: 14px; color: #d5bac0; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.visual-caption { text-align: right; margin-top: 9px; color: #969ba8; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .4px; }
.focus-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); border-top: 1px solid #35313a; padding: 22px 0 27px; }
.focus-item { padding: 0 22px; border-right: 1px solid #35313a; }
.focus-item:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.focus-item:last-child { padding-right: 0; border-right: 0; }
.focus-item strong { display: block; color: #eceaf0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 630; letter-spacing: -.1px; }
.focus-item span { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: #9c9eac; font-size: 10px; }
.section { padding-block: 52px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.section-alt { background: var(--pale); }
.section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 25px; }
.section-title { position: relative; padding-left: 14px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 730; letter-spacing: -.7px; }
.section-title::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); }
.section-kicker { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.3px; }
.section-intro { max-width: 820px; margin-top: -11px; margin-bottom: 26px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.85; }
.about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 326px; gap: 62px; align-items: start; }
.about-copy p { font-size: 14px; color: #545860; line-height: 1.9; }
.about-copy p + p { margin-top: 13px; }
.about-copy strong { color: #33363d; font-weight: 650; }
.text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.affiliations { padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--pale); }
.aside-label { margin-bottom: 13px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.affiliation-item + .affiliation-item { margin-top: 17px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.affiliation-item a { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; color: #33373d; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 650; }
.affiliation-item a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.affiliation-item p { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; }
.research-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 17px; }
.research-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 23px 22px 19px; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius); background: white; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(20,20,20,.025); transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s; }
.research-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: #d8b5bb; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(40,20,25,.065); }
.research-icon { width: 39px; height: 39px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 17px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.research-icon .icon { width: 23px; height: 23px; }
.research-card h3 { color: var(--accent-dark); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.25px; }
.research-card p { margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.85; }
.research-card .text-link { margin-top: auto; font-size: 11px; }
.work-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.filter { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 99px; color: var(--muted); background: white; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.filter:hover { border-color: #c9a2a9; color: var(--accent); }
.filter[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: white; }
.search-wrap { position: relative; width: 255px; max-width: 100%; }
.search-wrap .icon { position: absolute; top: 11px; left: 12px; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: #858892; pointer-events: none; }
.search-wrap input { width: 100%; min-height: 39px; padding: 8px 12px 8px 37px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--pale); font-size: 11px; }
.search-wrap input::placeholder { color: #747781; opacity: 1; }
.work-count { min-height: 22px; margin-bottom: 13px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.work-list { list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.work-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 126px minmax(0,1fr); column-gap: 23px; padding-block: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.work-thumb { position: relative; display: block; width: 126px; height: 112px; margin-top: 4px; border: 1px solid #e3e2e6; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #131720; }
.work-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.work-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.topic-badge { padding: 2px 8px; color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .1px; }
.work-type { color: #757982; font-size: 9px; }
.work-body h3 { max-width: 830px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; font-weight: 690; letter-spacing: -.15px; }
.work-summary { margin-top: 7px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8; }
.work-details { margin-top: 12px; }
.work-details summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding-block: 2px; color: var(--accent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; }
.work-details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.work-details summary::after { content: "+"; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 400; }
.work-details[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
.work-details .summary-close { display: none; }
.work-details[open] .summary-open { display: none; }
.work-details[open] .summary-close { display: inline; }
.overview { margin-top: 12px; border-left: 2px solid #d9b8bf; background: var(--pale); padding: 15px 19px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; }
.overview p { color: #555a63; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.9; }
.method-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 12px; list-style: none; }
.method-tags li { padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e5; border-radius: 4px; color: #626570; font-size: 9px; background: white; }
.publication-note { margin-top: 19px; color: #70737c; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.75; }
.empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 38px 15px; background: var(--pale); border: 1px dashed #d5c5ca; border-radius: var(--radius); }
.empty-state p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.empty-state button { border: 0; padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 60px; }
.contact-copy { max-width: 445px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.9; }
.contact-card { padding: 25px 27px; border: 1px solid #ddc9ce; border-radius: var(--radius); background: white; }
.contact-card .aside-label { margin-bottom: 7px; }
.email-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.2px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.contact-affiliation { margin-top: 11px; max-width: 355px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.75; }
.contact-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 19px; }
.contact-actions .button { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 11px; }
.copy-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 99px; background: white; color: #5b5f66; font-size: 11px; }
.copy-button:hover { background: var(--pale); color: var(--accent); }
.copy-button .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.copy-status { min-height: 17px; margin-top: 7px; color: var(--accent-dark); font-size: 10px; }
.footer { padding-block: 24px; background: #f0f0f2; }
.footer-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
.footer-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: #4e5159; }
.footer-note { font-size: 10px; color: #777a82; margin-top: 3px; }
.back-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #686c74; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.no-script { padding: 12px 20px; text-align: center; color: #5b2631; background: #f7e9ec; font-size: 12px; }
html[lang="zh-CN"] .hero-title { line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0; }
html[lang="zh-CN"] .hero-description { line-height: 2; }
html[lang="zh-CN"] .eyebrow { letter-spacing: .3px; }
html[lang="zh-CN"] .brand-subtitle { letter-spacing: .8px; }
@media (min-width: 1600px) { .hero-grid { padding-block: 68px 48px; } }
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .header-row { gap: 13px; min-height: 70px; }
  .brand { gap: 10px; }
  .brand-subtitle { font-size: 10px; }
  .site-nav { gap: 19px; }
  .site-nav a { font-size: 12px; }
  .hero-grid { gap: 27px; }
  .hero-description { font-size: 13px; }
  .hero-title { font-size: 27px; }
  .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px; gap: 35px; }
  .contact-grid { gap: 35px; }
  .email-link { font-size: 14px; }
}
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .container { width: calc(100% - 40px); }
  .js .menu-toggle { display: grid; }
  .header-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .js .header-row { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .site-nav { order: 5; width: 100%; gap: 18px; justify-content: center; }
  .site-nav a { padding: 10px 0; }
  .js .site-nav { display: none; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 100%; width: 100%; padding: 10px 20px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: white; box-shadow: 0 12px 18px rgba(20,20,20,.06); }
  .js .site-nav.is-open { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; align-items: stretch; }
  .js .site-nav a { padding: 12px 6px; font-size: 14px; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 5px; }
  .js .site-nav a[aria-current="location"] { background: var(--accent-soft); }
  .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-top: 42px; gap: 34px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 59px; }
  .hero-title { max-width: 550px; font-size: 32px; }
  .hero-description { max-width: 575px; font-size: 14px; }
  .hero-location { margin-top: 18px; }
  .hero-visual { max-width: 640px; width: 100%; }
  .mosaic { grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
  .mosaic-tile { aspect-ratio: .84; border-radius: 10px; }
  .mosaic-tile .tile-label { font-size: 10px; left: 10px; bottom: 11px; }
  .tile-number { left: 10px; }
  .focus-item { padding-inline: 15px; }
  .focus-item strong { font-size: 12px; }
  .focus-item span { font-size: 9px; }
  .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 25px; }
  .affiliations { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 15px 24px; padding: 20px 23px; }
  .affiliations .aside-label { grid-column: 1/-1; margin: 0; }
  .affiliation-item + .affiliation-item { margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; border-top: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .research-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
  .contact-copy { max-width: 610px; }
  .contact-card { max-width: 520px; }
  .section { padding-block: 40px; }
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  html { scroll-padding-top: 85px; }
  .container { width: calc(100% - 36px); }
  .brand-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; }
  .brand-name { font-size: 16px; }
  .brand-subtitle { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .7px; }
  .header-row { min-height: 65px; gap: 9px; }
  .language-toggle { min-width: 38px; min-height: 36px; padding-inline: 8px; font-size: 11px; }
  .menu-toggle { min-width: 37px; min-height: 37px; }
  .hero-grid { padding-block: 35px 28px; gap: 29px; }
  .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; gap: 7px; }
  .eyebrow::before { width: 17px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 51px; margin-top: 20px; letter-spacing: -2px; }
  .hero-title { font-size: 27px; margin-top: 15px; }
  .hero-description { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 15px; }
  .hero-actions { margin-top: 22px; gap: 8px; }
  .button { font-size: 11px; padding-inline: 16px; }
  .hero-location { font-size: 10px; }
  .mosaic { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .mosaic-tile { aspect-ratio: 1.35; }
  .mosaic-tile .tile-label { font-size: 11px; }
  .visual-caption { font-size: 8px; }
  .focus-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px 16px; padding-block: 20px 25px; }
  .focus-item, .focus-item:first-child, .focus-item:last-child { padding-inline: 0; }
  .focus-item:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; }
  .focus-item strong { font-size: 12px; }
  .focus-item span { font-size: 9px; }
  .section { padding-block: 34px; }
  .section-heading { margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .section-title { font-size: 22px; }
  .section-kicker { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .section-intro { font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .about-copy p { font-size: 13px; }
  .affiliations { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 13px; }
  .affiliation-item + .affiliation-item { padding: 13px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 0; }
  .research-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 13px; }
  .research-card { padding: 21px; }
  .research-icon { margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .research-card p { font-size: 12px; }

    <section class="section" id="about" aria-labelledby="about-heading">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="section-heading"><h2 class="section-title" id="about-heading" data-i18n="about.heading">About Me</h2><span class="section-kicker" data-i18n="about.kicker">From perception to action</span></div>
        <div class="about-grid">
          <div class="about-copy">
            <p data-i18n="about.p1">My research focuses on <strong>UAV control and navigation, information fusion for robotic systems, and cooperative coverage planning</strong>. I am interested in connecting environmental perception with motion and task planning for aerial robots operating in complex environments.</p>
            <p data-i18n="about.p2">My work includes multi-UAV coordination, aircraft visual inspection, dynamic occupancy mapping, and fixed-wing motion planning. I also study safety assurance and coordinated operations for eVTOL systems.</p>
            <a class="text-link" href="#contact"><span data-i18n="about.contact">Get in touch</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
          </div>

            <div class="affiliation-item"><a href="https://en.nwpu.edu.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><span data-i18n="about.npu">Northwestern Polytechnical University</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><p data-i18n="about.npu.dept">School of Automation</p></div>
          </aside>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section section-alt" id="research" aria-labelledby="research-heading">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="section-heading"><h2 class="section-title" id="research-heading" data-i18n="research.heading">Research Directions</h2><span class="section-kicker" data-i18n="research.kicker">Autonomous aerial systems</span></div>
        <p class="section-intro" data-i18n="research.intro">Methods that connect perception, planning and execution, with a focus on the constraints of real aerial missions.</p>
        <div class="research-grid">
          <article class="research-card">
            <div class="research-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.5"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="2.5"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="2.5"/><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="2.5"/><path d="m8 8 8 8m0-8-8 8M9 12h6"/></svg></div>
            <h3 data-i18n="research.coverage.title">Multi-UAV Cooperative Planning</h3><p data-i18n="research.coverage.body">Task allocation and coverage path planning with energy, communication and coordination constraints.</p><a class="text-link" href="#selected-work" data-work-filter="planning"><span data-i18n="research.related">Related work</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          </article>
          <article class="research-card">
            <div class="research-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 2 8 7 4v2l-8-2v5l3 2v1l-4-1-4 1v-1l3-2v-5l-8 2v-2l7-4 2-8Z"/></svg></div>
            <h3 data-i18n="research.inspection.title">Autonomous Aircraft Inspection</h3><p data-i18n="research.inspection.body">Visibility-aware acquisition planning, visual defect segmentation and spatial documentation on aircraft surfaces.</p><a class="text-link" href="#selected-work" data-work-filter="inspection"><span data-i18n="research.related">Related work</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          </article>
          <article class="research-card">

            <h3 data-i18n="research.mapping.title">Robotic Perception &amp; Mapping</h3><p data-i18n="research.mapping.body">Information fusion and evidential occupancy representations for UAV navigation in dynamic environments.</p><a class="text-link" href="#selected-work" data-work-filter="mapping"><span data-i18n="research.related">Related work</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          </article>

            <h3 data-i18n="research.motion.title">Fixed-Wing Motion Planning</h3><p data-i18n="research.motion.body">Heuristic search and feasible trajectory generation for small fixed-wing UAVs in cluttered low-altitude airspace.</p><a class="text-link" href="#selected-work" data-work-filter="planning"><span data-i18n="research.related">Related work</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          </article>

            <h3 data-i18n="research.safety.title">eVTOL Safety &amp; Navigation</h3><p data-i18n="research.safety.body">Autonomous navigation, flight-control safety monitoring and operational validation in complex environments.</p><a class="text-link" href="#contact"><span data-i18n="research.discuss">Discuss this direction</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          </article>
          <article class="research-card">
            <div class="research-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="3" width="6" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="16" y="3" width="6" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="9" y="16" width="6" height="5" rx="1"/><path d="M5 8v4h14V8m-7 4v4"/></svg></div>
            <h3 data-i18n="research.operations.title">Coordinated Air Mobility</h3><p data-i18n="research.operations.body">Multi-vertiport state modelling, rolling-horizon scheduling, and coordination between scheduling and flight trajectories.</p><a class="text-link" href="#contact"><span data-i18n="research.discuss">Discuss this direction</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          </article>
        </div>

// The search helpers are independent of the interface so they can be checked directly.
function normalizeSearch(value) {

}
function matchesResearch(record, topic, query) {
  const topicMatch = topic === 'all' || record.topics.includes(topic);
  const terms = normalizeSearch(query).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
  const haystack = normalizeSearch(record.search);
  return topicMatch && terms.every(term => haystack.includes(term));
}

    'contact.send': '发送邮件',
    'contact.copy': '复制邮箱',
    'footer.note': '空中机器人 · 运动规划 · 环境感知 · 自主巡检',
    'footer.top': '返回顶部'
  };

  const translatable = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]'));
  const en = Object.fromEntries(translatable.map(el => [el.dataset.i18n, el.innerHTML]));
  const nav = document.getElementById('site-nav');
  const menuButton = document.getElementById('menu-toggle');
  const languageButton = document.getElementById('language-toggle');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('work-search');
  const count = document.getElementById('work-count');
  const filters = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]'));
  const records = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.work-item')).map(el => ({
    element: el,
    topics: el.dataset.topics.split(' '),
    search: [el.dataset.search, el.textContent, ...Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]')).map(node => zh[node.dataset.i18n] || '')].join(' ')
  }));
  const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');
  const copyButton = document.getElementById('copy-email');
  const copyStatus = document.getElementById('copy-status');
  let language = 'en';
  let selectedTopic = 'all';
  let feedbackTimer;

  function applyFilters() {
    let visible = 0;
    for (const record of records) {
      const matches = matchesResearch(record, selectedTopic, searchInput.value);
      record.element.hidden = !matches;
      if (matches) visible += 1;
    }
    filters.forEach(button => button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.filter === selectedTopic)));
    count.textContent = language === 'zh' ? `显示 ${visible} / ${records.length} 项研究` : `Showing ${visible} of ${records.length} research entries`;
    emptyState.hidden = visible !== 0;
    document.getElementById('work-list').hidden = visible === 0;
  }

  function setMenu(open, restoreFocus = false) {
    nav.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
    menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    menuButton.setAttribute('aria-label', language === 'zh' ? (open ? '关闭导航' : '打开导航') : (open ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation'));
    if (!open && restoreFocus) menuButton.focus();
  }

  function setLanguage(nextLanguage, remember = false) {
    language = nextLanguage === 'zh' ? 'zh' : 'en';
    const messages = language === 'zh' ? zh : en;
    translatable.forEach(el => {
      const message = messages[el.dataset.i18n];
      if (typeof message === 'string') el.innerHTML = message;
    });
    document.documentElement.lang = language === 'zh' ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
    document.title = language === 'zh' ? 'Zheng Tan | 个人学术主页' : 'Zheng Tan | Academic Homepage';
    document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]').content = language === 'zh'
      ? 'Zheng Tan 的个人学术主页：无人机导航、多机协同覆盖规划、机器人感知与航空器自主巡检。'
      : "Zheng Tan's academic homepage: UAV navigation, cooperative coverage planning, robotic perception and autonomous aircraft inspection.";
    languageButton.textContent = language === 'zh' ? 'EN' : '中文';
    languageButton.setAttribute('aria-label', language === 'zh' ? 'Switch to English' : '切换为简体中文');
    nav.setAttribute('aria-label', language === 'zh' ? '主导航' : 'Main navigation');
    document.querySelector('.filters').setAttribute('aria-label', language === 'zh' ? '按主题筛选研究' : 'Filter research by topic');
    searchInput.placeholder = language === 'zh' ? '搜索题目、主题或方法…' : 'Search titles, topics, methods…';
    copyStatus.textContent = '';
    clearTimeout(feedbackTimer);
    setMenu(nav.classList.contains('is-open'));
    applyFilters();
    if (remember) {
      try { localStorage.setItem('zheng-tan-homepage-language', language); } catch (_) { /* Private modes can disable storage. */ }
    }
  }

  menuButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = menuButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
    setMenu(open);
    if (open) nav.querySelector('a').focus();
  });
  nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', () => setMenu(false)));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape' && nav.classList.contains('is-open')) setMenu(false, true);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (nav.classList.contains('is-open') && !event.target.closest('.masthead')) setMenu(false);
  });
  const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 801px)');
  const onViewportChange = event => { if (event.matches) setMenu(false); };
  if (desktopQuery.addEventListener) desktopQuery.addEventListener('change', onViewportChange);
  else if (desktopQuery.addListener) desktopQuery.addListener(onViewportChange);

  languageButton.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguage(language === 'en' ? 'zh' : 'en', true));
  filters.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    selectedTopic = button.dataset.filter;
    applyFilters();
  }));
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', applyFilters);
  document.getElementById('clear-filters').addEventListener('click', () => {
    selectedTopic = 'all';
    searchInput.value = '';
    applyFilters();
    searchInput.focus();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-work-filter]').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', () => {
    selectedTopic = link.dataset.workFilter;
    searchInput.value = '';
    applyFilters();
  }));

  const sectionLinks = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('a'));
  function markSection(id) {
    sectionLinks.forEach(link => {
      if (link.getAttribute('href') === `#${id}`) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location');
      else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      const visible = entries.filter(entry => entry.isIntersecting);
      if (visible.length) markSection(visible[0].target.id);
    }, { rootMargin: '-16% 0px -54% 0px', threshold: 0 });
    document.querySelectorAll('main section[id]').forEach(section => observer.observe(section));
    const heroObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting) markSection('');
    }, { threshold: .65 });
    heroObserver.observe(document.querySelector('.hero'));
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => markSection(window.location.hash.slice(1)));

  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    const input = document.createElement('textarea');
    input.value = text;
    input.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    input.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;';
    document.body.appendChild(input);
    let successful = false;
    try {
      input.select();
      successful = typeof document.execCommand === 'function' && document.execCommand('copy');
    } catch (_) { successful = false; }
    input.remove();
    return successful;
  }
  copyButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const email = document.getElementById('email-link').getAttribute('href').slice(7);
    let successful = false;
    copyButton.disabled = true;
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(email);
        successful = true;
      }
    } catch (_) { successful = false; }
    if (!successful) successful = fallbackCopy(email);
    copyButton.disabled = false;
    copyButton.focus();
    copyStatus.textContent = successful
      ? (language === 'zh' ? '邮箱地址已复制。' : 'Email address copied.')
      : (language === 'zh' ? '请选中上方邮箱地址并复制。' : 'Please select and copy the email address above.');
    clearTimeout(feedbackTimer);
    feedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => { copyStatus.textContent = ''; }, 7000);
  });

  languageButton.hidden = false;
  menuButton.hidden = false;
  copyButton.hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('work-toolbar').hidden = false;
  count.hidden = false;
  let savedLanguage = 'en';
  try { savedLanguage = localStorage.getItem('zheng-tan-homepage-language') || 'en'; } catch (_) { /* English is the default. */ }
  setLanguage(savedLanguage);
  if (window.location.hash) markSection(window.location.hash.slice(1));
})();
</script>
